name: Ambient noise interferometry
definition: Cross-correlating ambient seismic or acoustic noise between sensors (or components) to measure Green's functions and their changes (dv/v).

name: Earthquake detection and cataloging
definition: Detecting and picking events to build catalogs (STA/LTA, phase pickers, automated catalogs).

name: Template matching (matched filter)
definition: Scanning continuous data with waveform templates of known events to detect repeats.

name: Seismic tomography and waveform inversion
definition: Imaging seismic velocity structure from travel times or full waveforms.

name: Seismic reflection imaging
definition: Imaging subsurface structure with active-source multichannel or 3-D reflection surveys.

name: Focal mechanisms and moment tensors

name: Earthquake source parameters

name: b-value / frequency-magnitude analysis

name: Seafloor compliance

name: Surface-wave dispersion
definition: Rayleigh/Love wave dispersion and phase velocity for crustal and lithospheric structure.

name: Tremor detection and location

name: Acoustic ranging (horizontal geodesy)

name: GNSS/GPS geodesy and leveling

name: Deformation source modeling

name: Distributed temperature sensing (DTS)
